answer: A payout is split thus 26% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The dune schedule is applied in umber and whisper exposes each instalment. Anyone as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3019 identities would post 4557 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
